capabilities: Detect broken links to missing notes, headings, and blocks
Detect embeds and markdown links pointing to missing files
List empty notes that contain only frontmatter
Navigate to broken links from a side panel or dashboard
Filter and group results by type, folder, and note
disambiguation: Not a link fixer; it only reports broken links and never edits notes, with no fix buttons by design.
extras: Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Needs Obsidian 1.13 or later (older versions get 0.1.1). Privacy notes: reads only file paths, never file contents, and makes no network requests. Developer docs live in a separate docs/ folder.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in view of which wiki links, markdown links, and embeds point to files, headings, or blocks that don't exist, or which notes are empty.
summary: Broken link checker that scans a vault for links to missing notes, headings, blocks, and embeds, and lists empty notes.
